description: 对话练习：项目式学习三个阶段的完整内容，角色扮演跟读

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Hi, I'm Jack. Let me tell you something about myself.
lines.chinese: 嗨，我是Jack。让我来介绍一下我自己。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I have many good habits.
lines.chinese: 我有很多好习惯。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I get up early every day. I'm never late for school.
lines.chinese: 我每天早起。我上学从不迟到。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I'm honest. I always tell the truth.
lines.chinese: 我很诚实。我总是说实话。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I study hard and I try my best in everything.
lines.chinese: 我学习努力，每件事都尽我最大努力。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: But I also have some bad habits.
lines.chinese: 但是我也有一些坏习惯。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Sometimes I spend too much time on my phone.
lines.chinese: 有时候我在手机上花太多时间。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I don't like doing housework.
lines.chinese: 我不喜欢做家务。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: And I'm not very brave. I'm afraid of speaking in public.
lines.chinese: 而且我不太勇敢。我害怕在公共场合讲话。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: What about you? Do you have good habits and bad habits too?
lines.chinese: 你呢？你也有好习惯和坏习惯吗？

sections.title: Part 2 — Plan for yourself（自我规划）

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: We can become better by working on our weak points.
lines.chinese: 我们可以通过改进我们的不足来变得更好。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I'm going to make a plan for myself.
lines.chinese: 我打算为自己制定一个计划。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: First, I will limit my screen time to one hour a day.
lines.chinese: 第一，我要把屏幕时间限制在每天一小时。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Second, I'm going to help my parents with housework every weekend.
lines.chinese: 第二，我打算每个周末帮我父母做家务。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Third, I will join the school speech club to become braver.
lines.chinese: 第三，我要加入学校演讲俱乐部来变得更勇敢。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I know change is not easy.
lines.chinese: 我知道改变不容易。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: But I will try my best to become a better me.
lines.chinese: 但是我会尽我最大努力成为更好的自己。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: We can become better by being honest and hard-working.
lines.chinese: 我们可以通过诚实和勤奋变得更好。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Small changes can make a big difference.
lines.chinese: 小小的改变能带来大大的不同。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: My name is Jack.
lines.chinese: 我叫Jack。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I'd like to share my plan for becoming a better me.
lines.chinese: 我想分享我成为更好的自己的计划。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I am good at many things. I study hard and I'm honest.
lines.chinese: 我擅长很多事情。我学习努力，我很诚实。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: But I also have things to improve.
lines.chinese: 但是我也有需要改进的地方。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I spend too much time on my phone and I'm afraid of speaking in public.
lines.chinese: 我在手机上花太多时间，而且我害怕在公共场合讲话。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: So I have a three-part plan.
lines.chinese: 所以我制定了一个三部分的计划。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: First, I will limit my screen time.
lines.chinese: 第一，我要限制我的屏幕时间。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Second, I will help more with housework.
lines.chinese: 第二，我要更多地帮忙做家务。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Third, I will practice speaking in front of people.
lines.chinese: 第三，我要练习在人们面前讲话。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: I believe I can make it.
lines.chinese: 我相信我能做到。

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.english: Thank you for listening!
lines.chinese: 谢谢你们的聆听！
